protocol: By-eye held-out labels for live_ppo/eval/eval_units.py. Each frame was first labelled blind on a render with only the 18x32 detector tile grid (no detector boxes), then reconciled against zoom crops; detector output was looked at only to find units the blind pass missed, and was never copied as truth where it disagreed with the pixels. tile = continuous detector-grid ground point (x 0..17, y 0..31 from our King side, tile centres at integers, as common.ref_to_tile). Troops: feet. Flyers: bottom of the body (the detector's convention). Buildings: footprint centre. ref = tile_to_ref(tile) in 549x976 ref px. Classes are detector class names; -ev1/-hero are distinct; 'unknown' = a unit whose class could not be read (scored for presence only). Flags: swarm, fly, bld, occ (overlapped), spell (under a spell effect), tower (within ~2 tiles of a tower), river (river or bridge rows), deploy (deploy timer showing), formq (Evo vs base form not certain from pixels: base-cannon skin vs Evo), sideq (team not certain), spl (a spell area/projectile, not a unit: excluded from troop metrics). Skeleton forms: purple glow = Evo, gold = base (detector and the Evo Skeleton art agree). vid_QD_1suWFNKo was never used for these.

added_2026_11_18.note: Appended expansion batch (same protocol as above).
